result.title: Counting Events, Not Seeing Them: Diagnosing and Repairing the Readout Failure in Video LLMs
result.comment: Preprint v1 (2026-10-21). 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. A corrected-prompt retrain of the REALCOUNT adaptation arms is in progress; v2 will update those results. Comments welcome
result.summary: Video LLMs fail conspicuously at counting how many times an object crosses the screen, a failure attributed to missing object permanence. Using construction-grounded synthetic testbeds with independently validated labels, we show this attribution is incomplete: the count signal is present but unread - linear probes decode per-window presence at 93% while global count decoding collapses to a duration confound. Concurrent work reports the same representation-output dissociation for repetition counting; we show that in exit-and-reappear event counting it is repairable: two readout-directed repairs (episode-localization supervision and a discrete event-symbol side channel) raise same-object counting from 46.7% to 65.0% (oracle 66.7%) on a chance-33% benchmark across 7B-30B systems. Transfer to an independent factory costs nothing, and an audit of the measurement apparatus exposes four data-integrity failures that had obscured the boundary. A real-video audit (REALCOUNT, n=18, blind-audited) shows the boundary persists - best 55.6% at chance 33.3% - and symbol transfer fails zero-shot. A 1-epoch in-domain adaptation bench is negative (six levers at 28-50%), but a 3-epoch schedule shows this is budget-limited for the symbol channel: with a 3-epoch schedule and sequence-disjoint oracle timelines the reader reaches 94.4% on REALCOUNT, and with the deployed detector's timelines a 2-epoch run reaches 72.2%. The residual gap is detector evidence and the reader's match to detector noise, not reader capacity: a frozen-feature boundary probe finds the signal weak (AUC 0.62 over a 0.51 permutation control) and non-transferring across clips (0.77 within-clip vs. 0.62 across windows).

AI.brief_summary: 论文用合成测试床诊断视频 LLM 的事件计数失败：逐窗口存在性可被线性探针解码（93%），全局计数读出却因时长混淆而崩溃，并尝试片段定位监督与离散事件符号旁路两种读出修复，另附真实视频审计。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「内部表征存在但未被读出使用」的失败模式，其探针解码、跨片段不迁移与符号通道零样本失效的结果，可供核查 latent 内容是否真正进入答案，以及读出监督与证据筛选的设计。
